check_each_original_result_below_first_a: Check each original result below first. A missing or unavailable result does not prove that no frame was sent. Querying never sends a frame.
i_understand_the_earlier_outcome_is_unco: I understand the earlier outcome is unconfirmed. Allow one new logical transmission, which may duplicate a physical effect.
use_check_result_for_each_unconfirmed_re: Use Check result for each unconfirmed request before acknowledging a new transmission.
send_once_creates_a_new_request_using_th: Send once creates a new request using the current frame. To inspect an earlier request without sending, use Check result.
recent_requests_results_can_be_checked_w: Recent requests · results can be checked without acquiring control.
earlier_request_time_and_frame_summary_u: Earlier request · time and frame summary unavailable
read_original_result_does_not_send: Read original result · does not send
backendSubmitted: Submitted to backend; bus delivery unconfirmed · {{receipt}}
unknownResult: Transmission outcome unknown. Do not resend automatically. Request: {{request}}. Use Check result to query without sending.
missingReceipt: Receipt unavailable: it may be pending, expired, or from an earlier service instance. This does not prove that no frame was sent. Do not resend automatically.
